story.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harms to children’s mental health

draft:
I'm watching with interest as a New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harms to children's mental health. 
This ruling sets a significant precedent for tech companies. 
I wonder how this will impact their development of AI-powered moderation tools. 
Will this lead to more robust safeguards for young users?
#AIethics #TechAccountability #MentalHealthMatters
